Why PaperHands Gym?

Most people don't lose money in crypto because of bad analysis. They lose it because of emotions.

Panic selling during a crash. FOMO buying at the top. Freezing when you should act. The #1 destroyer of crypto portfolios isn't bad strategy. It's psychology.

PaperHands Gym is a flight simulator for crypto volatility. You feel the pump euphoria, the crash panic, the "should I sell?" pressure. All with zero financial risk.

If you've already felt what a 40% crash feels like here, you're less likely to panic sell when it happens for real.

Discover whether you're 💎🙌 or 🧻🙌. Without paying to find out.
